# Mirc Glow

> Korean-inspired skincare brand from Bhatkal, Karnataka, India. Six creams and four sets built around avocado, glutathione and kojic acid. The four original creams contain aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid; Avocado Glow Cream 15g is avocado and aloe vera only; Glass Glow Cream 30g has glutathione, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, centella asiatica and alpha arbutin. Sold directly across India with free shipping, Cash on Delivery and 7-day returns on sealed jars. Orders are placed on WhatsApp (+91 99808 81230).

Important: Mirc Glow creams are cosmetics. They help skin feel softer and look smoother and more even. They do not change natural skin tone and are not intended to treat skin conditions. They are Korean-inspired; manufacturing details are printed on each pack.

## Skincare guides
- [How to Apply Night Cream the Right Way](https://mircglow.com/how-to-apply-night-cream/): Apply night cream 20 to 30 minutes before bed, on clean, slightly damp skin. Use a pea-sized amount for the face and a little more for the neck, warm it between your fingertips, then press and smooth it upward and outward. Keep it away from the eyelids.
- [Avocado Day Cream: How to Use It in the Morning](https://mircglow.com/avocado-day-cream/): Yes, you can use avocado cream in the day. Choose a light avocado cream, apply a layer smaller than a pea on clean, slightly damp skin, wait two minutes, and always finish with sunscreen. An avocado night cream is richer and is meant for the hours you sleep.
- [Avocado Cream for Dry Skin: Why It Works and How to Use It](https://mircglow.com/avocado-cream-for-dry-skin/): Avocado cream suits dry skin because dry skin is short of oil, and a rich avocado cream adds a cushioning layer that helps hold moisture in. Apply it to slightly damp skin after washing, use a little more in winter, and expect skin to feel softer within a few days.
- [Night Cream for Men: A Simple Guide to Getting Started](https://mircglow.com/night-cream-for-men/): Men do not need a special night cream; skin needs the same things whoever it belongs to. Wash your face at night, apply a pea-sized amount of a moisturising cream, and use sunscreen in the morning. If you shave at night, wait a few minutes before applying cream.
- [Night Cream for Oily Skin: How to Choose and Use One](https://mircglow.com/night-cream-for-oily-skin/): Yes, oily skin still needs a night cream. Washing removes moisture as well as oil, and skin that is left dry can look shinier the next day. Choose a light, non-greasy texture, use a thin layer on clean skin, and add less on the oiliest areas.
- [Best Night Cream for Glowing Skin in India: How to Choose](https://mircglow.com/best-night-cream-for-glowing-skin/): There is no single best night cream for glowing skin. The best one suits your skin type, has hydrating ingredients plus one for an even look (such as niacinamide, kojic acid or glutathione), and feels pleasant enough that you use it every night with sunscreen in the morning.
- [Kojic Acid Cream for Dark Spots: How to Use It and What to Expect](https://mircglow.com/kojic-acid-cream-for-dark-spots/): Kojic acid cream can help reduce the look of dark spots and uneven tone when used every night for at least 8 to 12 weeks, together with daily sunscreen. Patch test first, start a few nights a week if your skin is sensitive, and see a dermatologist for patches that spread or change.
- [Glass Skin Routine for Indian Skin: 6 Simple Steps](https://mircglow.com/glass-skin-routine-for-indian-skin/): A glass skin routine for Indian skin uses fewer, lighter layers than the Korean original and puts sunscreen first. The six steps are gentle cleanse, hydrating toner, a light serum, a moisturiser that suits the season, sunscreen every morning, and a richer night cream before bed.
- [Kojic Acid vs Glutathione: Which Is Right for Your Skin?](https://mircglow.com/kojic-acid-vs-glutathione/): Kojic acid is the more targeted choice for the look of dark spots and patchy tone. Glutathione is a gentler antioxidant used for an overall brighter, fresher look. You do not need both; one good cream used every night with daily sunscreen does most of the work, and many creams combine them.
- [How to Use Glutathione Cream: A Step-by-Step Routine](https://mircglow.com/how-to-use-glutathione-cream/): Use glutathione cream at night as the last step: cleanse, pat dry, apply a pea-sized amount to the face and neck, and use sunscreen every morning. Patch test before the first use, use it every night, and keep strong exfoliating acids on different nights.
- [How Long Does Glutathione Cream Take to Work?](https://mircglow.com/how-long-does-glutathione-cream-take-to-work/): Glutathione cream usually takes 8 to 12 weeks of nightly use to give a brighter, more even look. Skin often feels softer within the first week, but because skin renews itself about every 4 to 6 weeks, visible change takes at least one or two full cycles, and daily sunscreen is essential.
- [Glutathione Cream Side Effects: What Is Known and How to Stay Safe](https://mircglow.com/glutathione-cream-side-effects/): Side effects from glutathione creams are uncommon and usually mild: some redness, itching, dryness or small bumps. When a reaction happens, another ingredient in the jar is often the cause. Patch test for 24 to 48 hours first, and stop and see a doctor if a reaction does not settle.
- [Glutathione Cream Benefits: A Simple Guide for Beginners](https://mircglow.com/glutathione-cream-benefits/): A glutathione cream can help skin look brighter, fresher and more even, and its base keeps skin moisturised and smooth. It will not change your natural skin colour. Used every night with sunscreen in the morning, most people notice a fresher look over 8 to 12 weeks.
- [Avocado Night Cream Side Effects: What to Know Before You Start](https://mircglow.com/avocado-night-cream-side-effects/): Avocado night cream side effects are uncommon and usually mild: clogged pores or bumps on oily skin, redness or itching from fragrance or other ingredients, and a heavy feel if you use too much. Patch test first, start with a small amount, and stop if a reaction lasts.
- [Is Avocado Cream Good for Your Skin and Face?](https://mircglow.com/is-avocado-cream-good-for-your-skin/): Yes, for most people. Avocado cream is a rich, comforting moisturiser that helps dry or tight skin feel soft and look smoother, which makes the face look fresher. On its own it does not lighten skin or remove dark spots. Choose the texture by skin type and use a small amount.
- [Which Is the No. 1 Night Cream in India?](https://mircglow.com/which-is-the-no-1-night-cream-in-india/): There is no single No. 1 night cream for everyone in India. The right one suits your skin type and climate, has hydrating ingredients, feels comfortable enough to use every night, and fits the rest of your routine. Check the ingredients and texture rather than a 'No. 1' label.
- [Is Avocado Night Cream Good?](https://mircglow.com/is-avocado-night-cream-good/): Avocado night cream is a good choice when your skin feels dry or tight at night. Its rich, cushiony texture helps skin feel moisturised and look soft by morning. It may feel too heavy for very oily skin, so the best fit depends on your skin type and how much you use.
- [How to Make Avocado Night Cream at Home?](https://mircglow.com/how-to-make-avocado-night-cream-at-home/): You can make a simple avocado night cream at home by blending ripe avocado with a little gentle oil and aloe gel. It has no preservative, so make a small batch, keep it in the fridge, use it as a short mask, and throw away what is left within a day or two.
- [Can I Use Avocado Night Cream Every Night?](https://mircglow.com/can-i-use-avocado-night-cream-every-night/): Yes, most people can use avocado night cream every night if it feels comfortable on their skin. Start with a small amount on clean skin as your last step, and use it less often or more thinly if your skin feels heavy, congested or irritated.
- [How to Build a Simple Night Skincare Routine](https://mircglow.com/how-to-build-a-simple-night-skincare-routine/): A simple night skincare routine has four steps: cleanse, tone, treat and moisturise. It takes about three minutes. Wash off the day, pat on a hydrating toner, apply one treatment such as a serum if you use one, and finish with a night cream as the last step.
- [Avocado Oil vs Avocado Cream for Face: Which Is Better?](https://mircglow.com/avocado-oil-vs-avocado-cream-for-face/): For most faces, avocado cream is easier to use. Oil adds only oil and can feel heavy in heat and humidity, while a cream gives water and oil together and can carry ingredients like niacinamide. Oil suits very dry skin in small amounts.
- [Avocado Cream for Acne-Prone Skin: An Honest Guide](https://mircglow.com/avocado-cream-for-acne-prone-skin/): Avocado cream is a moisturiser, not a pimple product. Used in a thin layer after a patch test, it can help acne-prone skin feel comfortable and less stripped. Painful, deep or cystic acne needs a dermatologist, not a cosmetic cream.
- [Night Cream vs Day Cream: What Is the Difference?](https://mircglow.com/night-cream-vs-day-cream/): Day cream is light, absorbs fast and sits under sunscreen and make-up. Night cream is usually richer and stays on for hours while you sleep, so it can hold more nourishing oils and ingredients like kojic acid. Dry and combination skin often benefit from both; oily skin can manage with one.
- [Avocado Cream in Winter: A Simple Winter Face Cream Guide for India](https://mircglow.com/avocado-cream-in-winter/): Yes, avocado cream suits winter well. Its rich oils help dry, tight skin feel soft and comfortable. Apply a pea-sized amount on slightly damp skin at night, add a thin layer in the morning if needed, and always finish the morning with sunscreen.
- [How to Choose Avocado Cream: What to Look For on the Label](https://mircglow.com/how-to-choose-avocado-cream/): Start with the ingredient list: avocado (Persea gratissima or Persea americana) should be easy to find, with supporting ingredients that suit your skin. Then match the texture to your skin type, check for a sealed jar and expiry date, and compare price per gram.
- [Avocado Cream for Oily Skin: How to Use It Without the Shine](https://mircglow.com/avocado-cream-for-oily-skin/): Yes, oily skin can use avocado cream. Use about half a pea-sized amount at night, start on the cheeks and spread only a thin leftover layer on the T-zone. In the day, many people with oily skin just use sunscreen, which is essential with kojic acid.
- [Winter Skincare Routine in India: A Simple Morning and Night Guide](https://mircglow.com/winter-skincare-routine-india/): In an Indian winter, use a gentle cleanser, a richer moisturiser on damp skin and SPF 30 sunscreen every morning. At night, cleanse well and apply a pea-sized night cream to the face and neck. Use lukewarm water, exfoliate once a week at most and patch test new products.
- [Avocado Cream for Combination Skin: The Zone Method](https://mircglow.com/avocado-cream-for-combination-skin/): Avocado cream suits combination skin when you apply it unevenly. Press most of a pea-sized amount into the dry cheeks, then use only what is left on your fingers for the forehead, nose and chin. Finish with sunscreen every morning.
- [Night Cream for Dry Skin in Winter: A Simple Routine](https://mircglow.com/night-cream-for-dry-skin-in-winter/): Choose a richer night cream with nourishing oils like avocado and water-holding aloe vera. Apply it on slightly damp skin after a lukewarm wash, add a thin second layer on dry patches, and keep using sunscreen in the morning, as the winter sun in India is still strong.
- [Avocado Cream vs Aloe Vera Gel: Which Suits Your Skin?](https://mircglow.com/avocado-cream-vs-aloe-vera-gel/): Aloe vera gel is light and cooling, best for oily skin, summer days and after sun. Avocado cream is richer and helps hold moisture in, better for dry, normal and most skin at night. You can layer both: gel first, then cream.
- [Can I Use Night Cream in the Day?](https://mircglow.com/can-i-use-night-cream-in-the-day/): Yes, in many cases. Use about half your night-time amount, let it settle for a few minutes, then always apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen of SPF 30 or more. It suits dry or normal skin and winter best; oily skin in hot, humid weather usually does better with a lighter day cream.
- [Avocado Cream for Sensitive Skin: How to Start Safely](https://mircglow.com/avocado-cream-for-sensitive-skin/): Avocado cream can feel comfortable on sensitive skin, but start slowly because it contains niacinamide and kojic acid. Patch test for three nights, then use it every third night for two weeks and build up only if skin stays calm. Wear sunscreen daily.
- [Glutathione vs Vitamin C: Which Is Better for Dull Skin?](https://mircglow.com/glutathione-vs-vitamin-c/): Neither simply wins. Vitamin C is the better-studied antioxidant for a brighter, more even-looking tone, while glutathione is usually gentler and suits a night cream. Many people use both: vitamin C in the morning under sunscreen, glutathione at night, or one cream that contains the two.
- [Avocado Cream Price in India: What You Are Really Paying For](https://mircglow.com/avocado-cream-price-in-india/): Avocado cream price in India depends on jar size, ingredients, packaging and price per gram. Mirc Glow avocado creams cost ₹349 for 10 g and ₹649 for 25 g or 30 g, so the larger jars work out to about ₹21–26 per gram.
- [How Much Night Cream to Use: A Simple Guide](https://mircglow.com/how-much-night-cream-to-use/): For most people, a pea-sized amount covers the whole face, with about half that again for the neck. Oily skin and humid weather need less; dry skin and winter need a little more. If your face feels sticky ten minutes later, use less next time.
- [Avocado Cream for Men: A Simple 1-Minute Routine](https://mircglow.com/avocado-cream-for-men/): Avocado cream works for men just as it does for women. Use a pea-sized amount at night on clean skin, less on oily areas, and wear sunscreen every morning. After shaving, wait 5 to 10 minutes and avoid any cuts or razor burn.
- [Can I Use Niacinamide and Kojic Acid Together?](https://mircglow.com/niacinamide-and-kojic-acid-together/): Yes. Niacinamide and kojic acid work in different ways and do not cancel each other out, so many creams combine them. Start every second night for two weeks, apply the thinner product first, avoid stacking other strong actives, and wear sunscreen every morning.
- [Avocado Night Cream for Women in Their 30s: A Simple Routine](https://mircglow.com/avocado-night-cream-for-30s/): In your 30s, skin often feels drier and fine lines look more noticeable when it is dehydrated. A pea-sized amount of avocado night cream on damp skin helps it feel moisturised and look smoother by morning. Pair it with sunscreen every day.
- [Night Cream for Combination Skin: How to Choose and Apply](https://mircglow.com/night-cream-for-combination-skin/): Pick a medium-weight, non-greasy cream with ingredients like aloe vera and niacinamide. Apply it to the cheeks first, then use only the leftover on your fingers for the forehead, nose and chin. Use a little less in summer and monsoon, and a little more in winter.
- [Avocado Cream vs Shea Butter Cream: Which Is Better for Your Skin?](https://mircglow.com/avocado-cream-vs-shea-butter-cream/): Avocado cream feels softer and sinks in more easily, so it suits most Indian faces through heat and humidity. Shea butter is thicker and sits on the surface, making it better for very dry patches, hands, feet and lips. Many people happily use both.
- [Kojic Acid Cream Side Effects: What to Watch For](https://mircglow.com/kojic-acid-side-effects/): The most common kojic acid cream side effects are mild stinging, redness, dryness or flaking in the first weeks. Itching, a rash or swelling can mean an allergic reaction, so stop and see a doctor if it does not settle. Patch test, start slowly and wear sunscreen daily.
- [Can I Use Avocado Cream Under My Eyes? A Safe How-To](https://mircglow.com/avocado-cream-around-eyes/): Yes, a rice-grain amount of avocado cream can be patted onto the orbital bone and outer eye corners, but keep it off the eyelids and lash line. If the cream contains kojic acid, patch test first, start a few nights a week and stop if it stings.
- [Serum Before or After Night Cream? How to Layer Them](https://mircglow.com/how-to-layer-serum-and-night-cream/): Serum goes before night cream. Apply thinnest to thickest: a watery serum on clean skin first, then the night cream on top to hold it in. Wait until the serum no longer feels wet, usually under a minute. Face oils go last, after the cream.
- [Night Cream for Sensitive Skin: How to Choose and Start Safely](https://mircglow.com/night-cream-for-sensitive-skin/): Choose a cream with a short ingredient list, little or no strong fragrance and soothing ingredients such as aloe vera. Patch test for three nights, then start every second or third night and build up slowly over two to three weeks, changing nothing else in your routine.
- [Glutathione Cream for Dark Spots: What It Can and Can't Do](https://mircglow.com/glutathione-cream-for-dark-spots/): A glutathione cream can help reduce the look of old pimple marks, tan and uneven tone over 8 to 12 weeks, especially when it also contains kojic acid and vitamin C. It needs daily sunscreen. Melasma or changing spots should be checked by a dermatologist.
- [Simple Skincare Routine for Working Women in India](https://mircglow.com/skincare-routine-for-working-women/): A simple routine for working women takes about five minutes a day. In the morning, cleanse, moisturise and apply SPF 30 sunscreen. At night, take off makeup, wash your face and apply a pea-sized night cream. Add extras only on days you have time.
- [Korean Skincare Routine for Oily Skin in India](https://mircglow.com/korean-skincare-routine-for-oily-skin/): For oily skin in India, keep the Korean basics but use fewer, lighter steps: a gel cleanser, one layer of hydrating toner, a light serum, a gel moisturiser and SPF 30 sunscreen. At night, double cleanse and use a thin layer of night cream.
- [Aloe Vera in Face Cream: Benefits and How to Use It](https://mircglow.com/aloe-vera-in-face-cream/): Aloe vera in a face cream helps skin feel moisturised and comfortable, gives the cream a lighter, cooling feel, and helps stronger ingredients like kojic acid feel gentler. It suits oily and combination skin well. It is not a sunscreen and does not change dark spots on its own.
- [Niacinamide Night Cream: Why Vitamin B3 Works Well at Night](https://mircglow.com/vitamin-b3-niacinamide-in-night-cream/): A niacinamide night cream is a moisturiser with vitamin B3. Niacinamide is gentle, pairs well with ingredients like kojic acid, helps oily skin look less shiny and supports a more even-looking tone. Use a pea-sized amount each night on clean skin, and wear sunscreen in the morning.
- [Summer Skincare Routine for Oily Skin in India](https://mircglow.com/summer-skincare-routine-india/): For oily skin in an Indian summer, wash with a gentle gel cleanser, use a light oil-free moisturiser and SPF 30 sunscreen in the morning, and reapply sunscreen outdoors. At night, double cleanse and use a thin layer of night cream. Avoid harsh scrubs.
- [Monsoon Skincare Routine: A Light, Simple Guide for Indian Skin](https://mircglow.com/monsoon-skincare-routine-india/): A good monsoon skincare routine is light: cleanse twice a day, use a gel moisturiser and SPF 30 sunscreen in the morning, and press a thin layer of night cream in at night. Dry your face after rain and keep towels and pillowcases fresh.
- [Alpha Arbutin Cream: What It Does for Dark Spots and How to Use It](https://mircglow.com/alpha-arbutin-cream/): An alpha arbutin cream helps dark spots and uneven patches look less noticeable by slowing new pigment, not by changing your natural skin colour. Use a pea-sized amount at night over the whole face, wear sunscreen every morning, and expect a more even look over 8 to 12 weeks.
- [Glutathione vs Alpha Arbutin: Which Is Right for Your Skin?](https://mircglow.com/glutathione-vs-alpha-arbutin/): Glutathione is an antioxidant for an all-over radiant, fresher look, while alpha arbutin is spot-focused and helps dark marks and patches look less noticeable. They do different jobs and work well together, either in one cream or one routine, with sunscreen every morning.
- [Centella Cream for Indian Skin: A Simple Guide to Cica](https://mircglow.com/centella-cream-for-indian-skin/): A centella cream, or cica cream, uses the centella asiatica plant to help skin feel calm, comfortable and moisturised. It suits most Indian skin types, especially oily or sensitive skin in heat and dry skin in AC. Use a pea-sized amount morning or night, with sunscreen in the day.
- [Hyaluronic Acid Night Cream: How to Use It in Indian Weather](https://mircglow.com/hyaluronic-acid-night-cream/): A hyaluronic acid night cream helps skin hold water overnight, so it feels softer and looks plumper and dewier by morning. Apply a pea-sized amount on slightly damp skin. In humid weather a thin layer is enough; in dry or AC weather, seal it with a richer cream.
- [Best Avocado Cream in India: An Honest Buyer's Guide](https://mircglow.com/best-avocado-cream-in-india/): The best avocado cream in India is the one that suits your skin type, has a clear ingredient list and fair price per gram. Choose a light gel-cream for oily skin, a richer night cream for dry skin, and kojic acid only if you will wear sunscreen daily.

## Common questions
- Is shipping free at Mirc Glow? Yes. Shipping is free on every order delivered within India.
- How long does delivery take? Most orders arrive in 3 to 7 days. You get a tracking number on WhatsApp or SMS when your parcel is dispatched.
- Does Mirc Glow offer Cash on Delivery? Yes. You can pay by Cash on Delivery, or ask for a secure online payment link when you order on WhatsApp.
- Does Mirc Glow deliver outside India? No. We currently deliver within India only.
- Can I return a Mirc Glow cream? Yes. Unopened, sealed jars can be returned within 7 days of delivery.
- What if my order arrives damaged or wrong? Tell us on WhatsApp within 7 days of delivery with a photo, and we will replace it or refund you.
- How long do refunds take? Refunds are made within 5 to 7 working days after we receive and check the return.
- Can I return an opened jar? Opened jars cannot be returned for hygiene reasons, unless the product arrived damaged, wrong or expired.
